newsitem.title: USA: Fleet to sell three units, buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Fleet to sell three units, buy back shares.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group said it will sell its Option One Mortgage Co, its indirect auto lending and its corporate trust businesses, and buy back up to 20 million shares of common stock during the next year.
The company did not say what prices it is seeking for the units. Fleet officials were not immediately available to comment. The company's stock last traded at 52-1/2, up 1/4.
Option One, which originates and services residential mortgages, services about 20,000 accounts totaling $1.9 billion, the company said.
The indirect auto lending unit has $1.7 billion in assets, Fleet added. The corporate trust unit generates revenues of between $20 million and $25 million a year, it also said.
